feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Zãlawo ƒe ŋkɔwo, mama wo me kple koma
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Wodzrae ɖo. Womekpɔ zãlawo ƒe ŋkɔ siawo o:
feature-preview-admins: Dzikpɔlawo kpɔa dɔwɔnu siwo metsi dɔ wɔm o be woado wo kpɔ gbã
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Ɖaŋɔ ƒe menu → Sewo doa se siwo tso nusi amewo wɔna kple asi enuenu.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Didi blibo se nyagbe abe "nye kaad siwo ƒe ɣeyiɣi va yi" ene gɔme.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Ɖaŋɔ ƒe menu → Tso wò sasrãkpɔ mamlɛtɔ dzi ɖe nusi bubuwo trɔ le ɖaŋɔ dzi fia.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Kalenda kple ŋɔŋlɔkpe geɖe ƒe kalenda.
feature-views-chat-desc: Ŋɔŋlɔkpe abe dzeɖoɖo ƒe dɔwɔƒe ene: dɔwɔƒewo, ŋɔŋlɔkpewo, mɔwo, xexlẽdzesiwo kple agbalẽviwo abe kanɛlwo ƒe ati ene, agbalẽvi la le titina eye eƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo abe dzeɖoɖo ƒe gbedeasiwo ene.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Agbalẽvi ɖeka mawo le tsitretsiɖoƒe ƒuƒoƒo geɖe siwo ŋkɔ le me - le wuwu nu, vevienyenye, dzesi vevi alo nu bubu ɖesiaɖe nu - wotsɔnɛ tso tsitretsiɖoƒe ɖeka yi bubu me to hehe me.
feature-views-email-desc: Ŋɔŋlɔkpe abe agbalẽɖaka ene: e-mail ƒe xexlẽdzesi enye Agbalẽ siwo va, xexlẽdzesiwo nye nudzraɖoƒewo, dzesiwo nye dzesiwo, eye hametɔwo ŋlɔa e-mailwo heɖoa wo ŋu tso ŋɔŋlɔkpe ƒe adrɛs dzi.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Dɔ siwo susɔ, dɔ siwo wowu enu, dɔyiyi ƒe ƒuƒoƒo, dɔwɔɣeyiɣi kple lalãɣeyiɣi, dɔ siwo wowu enu ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ, ɣeyiɣi si dɔwo lala, nuxetsinuwo, Monte Carlo kple dɔyiyi ƒe dzidzemɔnu bubuwo.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Gantt nɔnɔmetata kpɔkpɔ ƒe mɔ etɔ̃awo.
feature-views-map-desc: Agbalẽviwo abe dzesiwo le nɔnɔmetata si woda ɖo dzi ene.
feature-views-overview-desc: Xexlẽme, hatsotso ɖe ame si wotsɔ dɔ de asi nɛ nu, dɔwɔɖoɖo, nudzɔdzɔwo ƒe ŋɔŋlɔkpe kple ŋɔŋlɔkpe gã.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Nuwɔwɔ ƒe dɔ siwo susɔ, dɔwɔɣeyiɣi kpuiwo, ɣeyiɣi ma ƒe akɔnta kple dɔwɔwɔ ƒe kabakaba.
feature-views-table-desc: Ŋɔŋlɔkpe abe agbalẽviwo ƒe kpekpe si woate ŋu aɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu ene.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Ŋɔŋlɔkpe abe GitHub alo Gitea ƒe nyawo ƒe kpɔɖeŋu ene: agbalẽviwo abe nyawo ene, dzesiwo kple ŋkeke vevewo, nuŋɔŋlɔwo abe dzeɖoɖo ene, nu siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu abe faɛlwo ene, kple ŋɔŋlɔkpe ƒe ŋutinya kple gbugbɔgadzɔ.
